#### `IHttpHandler`

Defines the contract that ASP.NET implements to synchronously process HTTP Web requests using a custom HTTP handler.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IsReusable` | `bool IsReusable { get; }` | Gets a value indicating whether another request can use the `IHttpHandler` instance. |
| `ProcessRequest` | `void ProcessRequest(HttpContext context)` | Enables processing of HTTP Web requests by a custom HttpHandler that implements the `IHttpHandler` interface. |

#### `IHttpModule`

Provides module initialization and disposal events to the implementing class.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dispose` | `void Dispose()` | Disposes of the resources (other than memory) used by the module that implements `IHttpModule`. |
| `Init` | `void Init(HttpApplication context)` | Initializes a module and prepares it to handle requests. |
